summary: Part 1 of 2 of the '11.1 Dashboard (Seller)' training (00:00 to about 05:01). The trainer shows the sign-in options (Google, or email instead), then the Seller Performance dashboard. Sign-in itself is not shown on screen: the Email and Password fields stay empty and the dashboard tab is already open. He narrates the header (buy box status, account manager, WhatsApp and Meeting buttons), then walks the Performance tab: timeframes, country and category filters, top KPI tiles, and the Orders, GMV, On time, Defect rate and Days to solve sections, each with a Methodology box. Claims coverage appears at the end without explanation. All 40 frames were opened and checked against the narration. The dashboard was recorded on a localhost demo build (localhost:8099) with demo seller 'Seller ABC', so its figures are demo data. Narration and screen agree on most definitions. Conflicts are logged as unclear: the on-time working-day limits for AE and ZA, and the meaning of several buttons and of GMV currency. Part 2 (from about 05:01) is not covered here.

terms.meaning: Buy box status shown in the dashboard header (open or closed). The trainer calls it the buy box status.
The seller's account manager, named in the narration and reachable from the dashboard header through WhatsApp or a Meeting booking.
An order counted on the day it was confirmed. Basis of the Orders KPI.
One confirmed order line. A three-item order counts as three.
Chart split by the market the order shipped to. Other groups all markets under 1.5% of the window.
Chart toggle between absolute counts and percentage view.
Chart toggle between a split by country and a split by product category.
Shows the raw data behind the KPI as a table.
Expandable box under each KPI that explains what is taken into account and what is not.
The shipment or delivery deadline clock used by the on-time KPI. A month whose clock has not run out is not judged.
Unit for the on-time limits: under 3 working days outside Saudi (shipment), within 5 working days in Saudi (delivery).
Orders counted in an on-time figure. A market with fewer than 10 judged orders in a month gets no figure of its own.
Qualifying warranty and return claims, set against confirmed orders, counted against the order's month. Listed claim types are excluded.

terms.term: Within 30 days of the order / Within 90 days of the order
terms.meaning: Defect rate computed only from claims filed within 30 or 90 days of the order. Final once those days have passed since the month closed.
Claim types excluded from the defect rate. RTO is not expanded on screen.
Calendar days from the claim date to the claim being resolved, keyed on the repair partner.
Claim types used to split days to solve. A return is resolved when the refund reaches the customer; a warranty when the device ships back or it is refunded instead.
Monthly split of claims that are solved or still open, with a coverage percentage. Meaning is not explained in part 1.
Key used for days to solve: the claims you repaired, as stated in the Days to solve methodology.
Implied: the label on KPI tiles for a period whose figures are not final. The narration does not define it.
Filter buttons for country and category. The narration does not define them.

unclear.issue: Narration says the 3-working-day shipment limit applies to UAE and South Africa. The screen says Outside Saudi, shipment under 3 working days (t00138.jpg). The chart legend on On time and On time shipment reads AE (≤ 2), ZA (≤ 2), SA (≤ 5) (t00135.jpg, t00151.jpg). The On time delivery legend reads AE (≤ 3), ZA (≤ 5), SA (≤ 5) (t00157.jpg), while its methodology covers Saudi only. The limit that applies to AE and ZA cannot be determined. Do not state a per-market limit for them.

Narration says KPIs compare with the months before. The screen compares with the previous period of the chosen grain: vs. Jun 26 (monthly), vs. Aug 17 (weekly), vs. Sep 2 (daily). The narration is probably loose wording, but the exact comparison period for each grain is only shown on screen.
Meaning of the buttons Core 3, Top 3 and Exclude SA is not explained in part 1. The countries or categories in each group are not stated.

GMV currency: the GMV figures carry a currency symbol on screen (shown as ₿ in the captured frames, e.g. t00097.jpg, t00128.jpg). The narration never names the currency, and the symbol could not be read with certainty. Do not state the currency.
No GMV methodology is opened or narrated in part 1 (the GMV Methodology button stays collapsed), so the GMV definition is not available in this evidence.

The meaning of the label 'still filling' on KPI tiles (for example DEFECT RATE 0.6% still filling on t00048.jpg) is not explained in the narration. The defect methodology implies the recent-month effect but does not define the label.
Claims coverage (Solved / Still open) is shown on screen (t00299.jpg) but neither its methodology nor the narration covers it in part 1. Its definition is not in this evidence.

Narration says 'the order management' while the screen names admin.revibe.me (t00025.jpg). This may be a paraphrase rather than a mishearing, so it is not logged as an ASR fix. Use the screen wording for the sign-in rule.
